name: treant
description: A walking tree, slowly moving on a tangle of roots like a land-bound octopus, with its branches swaying in the wind.  There is the vague suggestion of a face in the whorls of its bark.
//: 3 grabs due to dozens of roots useable as grabbing appendages.
